name: SuperStickyNote
desc: Floating sticky quick-notes for Supernote. Tap the launcher bubble and a draggable post-it appears over your notebook or document; type on it with the keyboard. Lasso handwriting or select PDF text to capture it into a sticky note that links back to its page, and put a note's text back on the page as an editable text box. Notes and .txt exports live in MyStyle/Plugins/SuperStickyNote.
